title: Concept: Django or Flask cookie configured with SameSite=None in python — review required
description: In python, a cookie setting opts into SameSite=None. For session and CSRF cookies that widens the set of requests that carry them, which is precisely the property CSRF defences try to remove. The setting is often copied to fix an embedded login flow and then left in place for every cookie.
applicability: python Django/Flask deployments configuring cookie policy.
risk: Cross-site request exposure for session cookies; MEDIUM severity.
